lesson.name: letter sounds
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 1
lesson.information: Learn 26 letter sounds and how to write them. Learn about vowels and consonants.

lesson.name: three letter 'cvc' words
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 2
lesson.information: Words that have a consonant-vowel-consonant are called 'cvc' e.g. cat.

lesson.name: help with 'b' 'd' confusion
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 3
lesson.information: Strategies to help overcome 'b' 'd' confusion.

lesson.name: closed and open syllables
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 4
lesson.information: Meet Silly Bull and learn about closed and open syllables.

lesson.name: words with 'sh'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 5
lesson.information: Make the 'sh' flash card and start collecting the Nessy phonic pack.

lesson.name: words with 'ch'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 6
lesson.information: 'ch' is the second phonic flash card.

lesson.name: words with 'th'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 7
lesson.information: Learn the two sounds made by 'th'. Use speech therapy techniques to hear the difference between 'th', 'f' and 'v'.

lesson.name: initial consonants (ccvc)
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 8
lesson.information: Words that begin with two consonants e.g. from, have a consonant-consonant-vowel-consonant or 'ccvc'.

lesson.name: 'y' as an 'i' sound
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 9
lesson.information: Where 'y' is at the end of a word it makes an 'i' sound e.g. fly.

lesson.name: Nessy Challenge game
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 10
lesson.information: Are you ready for the next island? Play the Nessy Challenge game to see if you have learnt all the lessons in this island.

lesson.name: flossy words end in 'ff' 'll' 'ss'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 1
lesson.information: Flossy words is a rule to help spell words ending in 'ff', 'll' and 'ss' e.g. stuff, still, fuss.

lesson.name: end consonants (cvcc)
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 2
lesson.information: Words that end with two consonants e.g. pink, have a consonant-vowel-consonant-consonant or 'cvcc'.

lesson.name: protector 'ck'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 3
lesson.information: Find out about Protectors with Norman the knight. This spelling rule will help you to spell with either a 'ck' or 'k'. You will also learn about kicking 'k' and cuddly 'c'.

lesson.name: words with 'ar'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 4
lesson.information: 'r' is using his love magic on 'a'. Together they make a new sound, 'ar' as in car. 'ar' is the first of five sounds called vowel 'r'.

lesson.name: words with 'or'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 5
lesson.information: 'r' is back again and this time he is using his magic on 'o'. Together they make a new sound, 'or' as in corn.

lesson.name: words with 'er' 'ir' 'ur'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 6
lesson.information: The last three vowel 'r' sounds, 'er', 'ir' and 'ur', all make the same sound e.g. fern, fir, fur.

lesson.name: 2 syllable words (cvc-cvc)
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 7
lesson.information: Join the Syllable Division and learn how to split and read words into smaller, more manageable chunks. Play Chimp Fu and see if you can chop up giant hotdogs!.

lesson.name: word endings 1
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 8
lesson.information: Dr Strange explains about the Head Body and Tail of words. Word endings are also called suffixes but Nessy calls them 'tails'. Learn the tails 'ing', 's', 'es', 'y' and 'er'. Find out about plurals.

lesson.name: phonic sounds: 'ee' and 'ea'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 9
lesson.information: Together the two vowels make one sound e.g. meet, meat. Add these flash cards to your pack of Phonic Sounds.

lesson.name: Nessy Challenge game
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 10
lesson.information: Are you ready for the next island? Play the Nessy Challenge game to see if you have learnt all the lessons in this island.

lesson.name: magic 'e'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 1
lesson.information: Watch the heroic sacrifice of magic 'e' who gives all his power to the vowel. 'e' at the end of a word changes the vowel sound but remains silent e.g. can - cane.

lesson.name: soft 'c' and soft 'g'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 2
lesson.information: You might think 'c' has a hard sound as 'cat' but it can also be a great big softy! Where 'c' or 'g' is followed by 'i', 'y', 'e' the sound changes to become soft e.g. rice, rage.

lesson.name: words with 'wh' and 'qu'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 3
lesson.information: 'wh' and 'qu' are two new sounds to add to the phonic sounds pack of flash cards e.g. when, quiz.

lesson.name: phonic sounds: 'ai' and 'ay'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 4
lesson.information: Listen to the phonic sounds rap to find out why these two letters make one sound! e.g. train, tray.

lesson.name: phonic sounds: 'igh','ie' and 'y'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 5
lesson.information: Meet the incredible knight in tights! These phonic sounds make the 'i' sound e.g. light, lie.

lesson.name: phonic sounds: 'oa', 'ow' and 'oe'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 6
lesson.information: Can you find the coat in a goat? All these phonic sounds make an 'o' sound e.g. goat, snow, toe.

lesson.name: phonic sound: 'oo'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 7
lesson.information: The phonic sound 'oo' makes two sounds e.g. moon, wood.

lesson.name: protector 'tch'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 8
lesson.information: See Norman the knight battle Gorgo the monster. The second Protector will tell you when to spell with a 'tch' or 'ch' e.g. pitch, pinch.

lesson.name: 2 syllable vowel 'r' (ar/or/ir/ur)
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 9
lesson.information: Now read 'ar', 'or', 'ir' and 'ur' in two syllable words e.g. carpet, corner, thirsty, murder.

lesson.name: Nessy Challenge game
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 10
lesson.information: Are you ready for the next island? Play the Nessy Challenge game to see if you have learnt all the lessons in this island.

lesson.name: triple consonants (cccvc)
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 1
lesson.information: These words have three consonants together (shr/spr/scr/str/thr/spl) e.g. shrug.

lesson.name: harder 2 syllable words
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 2
lesson.information: These two syllable words are even harder than the ones in Island 2 because they have double consonants at the beginning or end e.g. trumpet, contract.

lesson.name: 'a' sounds like 'ar' before s/f/th
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 3
lesson.information: This spelling rule will be helpful if you put an extra 'r' in words by mistake. There is no 'r' before the letters 's', 'f' and 'th' e.g. past, after, father.

lesson.name: open syllables 2
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 4
lesson.information: Return to the Syllable Division to continue your training with Chimp Fu. Learn where to split the word to find an open syllable e.g. pi-lot by chopping giant vegetables.

lesson.name: magic 'e' 2
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 5
lesson.information: Now the magic 'e' is at the end of two syllable words! e.g. pancake.

lesson.name: words ending in 'ed'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 6
lesson.information: Add 'ed' to your pack of tails flash cards. Learn the three sounds 'id', 't' and 'd' e.g. hunted, hopped, played.

lesson.name: phonic sounds: 'ui', 'ue' and 'ew'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 7
lesson.information: All these phonic sounds make an 'oo' sound e.g. fruit, clue, stew.

lesson.name: phonic sounds: 'oi' and 'oy'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 8
lesson.information: 'oi' and 'oy' make the same sound e.g. coin, toy. Add them to your pack of phonic sounds flash cards.

lesson.name: phonic sounds: 'ou' and 'ow'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 9
lesson.information: 'ou' and 'ow' make the same sound e.g. count, cow. Find out the spelling rule to help you know which one to use.

lesson.name: Nessy Challenge game
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 10
lesson.information: Are you ready for the next island? Play the Nessy Challenge game to see if you have learnt all the lessons in this island.

lesson.name: words with 'ph'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 1
lesson.information: The ancient Greeks gave us the 'ph' sound of 'f' e.g. dolphin.

lesson.name: protector 'dge'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 2
lesson.information: The third and final Protector will explain when to spell with a 'dge' or 'ge' e.g. fridge, fringe.

lesson.name: prefixes (heads)
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 3
lesson.information: The beginning of a word can be called a prefix but Dr Strange will explain them as 'heads' e.g. invent.

lesson.name: word endings 2
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 4
lesson.information: The second stage of 'tails'. Add the flash cards 'en', 'ful', 'et', 'ty', 'ly' and 'ish' to your pack.

lesson.name: rabbit and tiger
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 5
lesson.information: Watch the lovely rabbit words with a double consonant e.g. hopping. Tiger words only have a single consonant e.g. hoping.

lesson.name: vowel 'rr' (vrr)
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 6
lesson.information: Find out why a vowel next to 'rr' makes a different sound to a vowel in front of one 'r' e.g. car - carry.

lesson.name: words ending in 'le'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 7
lesson.information: Discover how lifting elephants can help you remember the sound of this word ending.

lesson.name: phonic sounds: 'ear' and 'air'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 8
lesson.information: Watch the hairy fairy and search for the ear. Add the phonic sounds 'ear' and 'air' to your pack of flash cards.

lesson.name: sounds saying 'or' (au/aw/oar)
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 9
lesson.information: Learn a rule to help you spell 'au' and 'aw' and add these phonic sounds to your flash card pack.

lesson.name: Nessy Challenge game
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 10
lesson.information: Are you ready for the next island? Play the Nessy Challenge game to see if you have learnt all the lessons in this island.

lesson.name: the 'w' rule: 'wa' 'wor' 'war'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 1
lesson.information: Find out why 'w' is such a wicked wizard! Learn the phonic sounds 'wa', 'wor' and 'war' e.g. wash, worm, warm.

lesson.name: suffixing - double, drop e
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 2
lesson.information: The doubling rule explains when to spell with a double consonant e.g. hop+ed=hopped. The drop 'e' rule explains when to keep or remove the 'e' e.g. hope+ed=hoped. These are both suffixing rules because it is the suffix (tail) that changes the body of the word.

lesson.name: silent letters
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 3
lesson.information: These words all have silent letters 'k' e.g. knife, 'w' e.g. 'write', 'b' e.g. thumb, 'u' e.g. build.

lesson.name: a vowel with an 're' (are/ire/ure)
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 4
lesson.information: 'r' and 'e' are both trying to use their power on the vowel. All together they make a new sound e.g.care, fire, pure.

lesson.name: 'o' making an 'u' sound
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 5
lesson.information: Sometimes 'o' makes an 'u' sound e.g. honey. The 'v' rule explains why you can't have two 'v's together.

lesson.name: words ending in 'ce' and 'se'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 6
lesson.information: 'ce' and 'se' make the same sound at the end of a word so are easily confused e.g. rice, rinse.

lesson.name: harder soft 'c' and soft 'g'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 7
lesson.information: Where 'c' or 'g' is followed by 'i', 'y', 'e' the sound changes to become soft e.g. circle, orange. This lesson builds upon the rule introduced in Island 3.

lesson.name: word endings 3
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 8
lesson.information: The third stage of word endings (tails) includes 'ment', 'less', 'est', 'some', 'age'.

lesson.name: compound words
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 9
lesson.information: Where two words join together to make a new one it is called a compound word e.g. firework.

lesson.name: Nessy Challenge game
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 10
lesson.information: Are you ready for the next island? Play the Nessy Challenge game to see if you have learnt all the lessons in this island.

lesson.name: the 'y' rule: change 'y' to 'i'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 1
lesson.information: The 'why aye' man will explain when to keep the 'y' and when to change it into an 'i'. This 'y' rule is the third and final suffixing rule.

lesson.name: links
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 2
lesson.information: A 'link' joins the body and the tail of the word e.g. funniest. It is squeezed together and makes an unusual sound.

lesson.name: words ending in 'tion' and 'sion'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 3
lesson.information: 'i' connects to 't' making a 'sh' sound e.g. station. 'i' connects to 's' making a 'zhun' sound e.g. explosion.

lesson.name: queen of witches: 'qua' 'squa'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 4
lesson.information: The queen of witches knows the same spell as the 'w' rule in Island 6. After 'qu' the 'a' says 'o' e.g. squash.

lesson.name: advanced plurals
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 5
lesson.information: Making a word plural becomes quite complicated. You need to know the 'y' rule, when to change an 'f' to a 'v' and what to do about words ending in 'o'.

lesson.name: 'ou' making an 'u' sound
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 6
lesson.information: 'ou' makes three sounds but this lesson includes words with an 'u' sound e.g. courage.

lesson.name: monster words: 'ough' and 'augh'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 7
lesson.information: Meet the Hairy Thing who will explain about monster words. 'ough' words make so many sounds they are monstrously difficult to read.

lesson.name: split vowels
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 8
lesson.information: In most words, two vowels together make one sound e.g. 'oi', coin. These words split up the vowels, each making their own sound e.g. 'io', violin.

lesson.name: sounds saying 'a' (a-e/ai/ei/ea)
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 9
lesson.information: All these letter combinations (a-e/ai/ei/ea/ay/ey) make an 'a' sound. Words that make the same sound but are spelt differently are called homophones e.g. pale, pail.

lesson.name: Nessy Challenge game
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 10
lesson.information: Are you ready for the next island? Play the Nessy Challenge game to see if you have learnt all the lessons in this island.

lesson.name: sounds saying 'i' (i-e/igh/y/ie)
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 1
lesson.information: All these letter combinations (i-e/igh/y/ie) make an 'i' sound. Resources include homophones for the 'i' sound e.g. sight, site.

lesson.name: sounds saying 'o' (o-e/oa/ow)
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 2
lesson.information: All these letter combinations (o-e/oa/ow/oe) make an 'o' sound. Resources include homophones for the 'o' sound e.g. groan, grown.

lesson.name: sounds saying 'oo' (u-e/ew/ui)
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 3
lesson.information: All these letter combinations (u-e/ew/ui/ue) make an 'oo' sound. Resources include homophones for the 'oo' sound e.g. root, route.

lesson.name: words with 'ie' and 'ei'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 4
lesson.information: Most people have heard the rhyme 'i' before 'e' except after 'c' but here is the complete rule with all the exceptions.

lesson.name: sounds saying 'e' (ee/ea/ie/ei/ey)
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 5
lesson.information: All these letter combinations (ee/ea/ie/ei/ey) make an 'e' sound. Resources include homophones for the 'e' sound e.g. heal, heel.

lesson.name: homophones
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 6
lesson.information: Some words have 'twin' that sound the same but is spelt differently e.g. their, there. Some of these 'homophones' have already been introduced but this lesson includes some of the most tricky. Enter the House of Fear to play a game with 'there' and 'their'.

lesson.name: harder words with 'ir' 'ur'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 7
lesson.information: All these letter combinations (ir/ur/ear/our) make an 'er' sound e.g. girder, hurtle, learn, glamour.

lesson.name: even harder soft 'c' and soft 'g'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 8
lesson.information: The third and final stage of words with a soft 'c' and soft 'g' includes the hardest multi-syllable words e.g. circulate, fragile.

lesson.name: word endings 4
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 9
lesson.information: The fourth stage of word endings (tails) includes 'ily', 'ity', 'ic', 'ical', 'ture','sure', 'oon', and 'eer'.

lesson.name: Nessy Challenge game
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 10
lesson.information: Are you ready for the next island? Play the Nessy Challenge game to see if you have learnt all the lessons in this island.

lesson.name: words ending in 'al' and 'el'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 1
lesson.information: The word endings 'al' and 'el' make the same sound 'ul' e.g. signal, tunnel. They do not usually cause problems for reading but are tricky to spell.

lesson.name: advanced suffixing
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 2
lesson.information: These are the most advanced suffixing rules e.g. label+ing=labelling.

lesson.name: harder words with 'au'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 3
lesson.information: Multi-syllable words with 'au' and 'aw' e.g. applause.

lesson.name: harder links
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 4
lesson.information: Advanced words that have a 'link' joining the body and the tail of the word e.g. lenient.

lesson.name: word endings 5
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 5
lesson.information: The fifth stage of word endings (tails) includes 'able', 'ible', 'ant', 'ent', 'ive', 'ine', 'our', 'ice', 'ite' and 'cy'.

lesson.name: words where 'ch' says 'k' and 'sh'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 6
lesson.information: Greek and French words have influenced English. 'ch' makes a 'k' sound in words that came from Greek e.g. chaos. 'ch' makes a 'sh' sound in words that came from French e.g. champagne.

lesson.name: harder words with 'ph'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 7
lesson.information: Multi-syllable words that include the 'ph' sound of 'f' e.g. phenomenon.

lesson.name: words with 'que'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 8
lesson.information: que' makes a 'k' sound e.g. unique.

lesson.name: words ending in 'ly'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 9
lesson.information: Learn how adding 'ly' can change the spelling of words e.g. basic - basically.

lesson.name: Nessy Challenge game
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 10
lesson.information: Are you ready for the next island? Play the Nessy Challenge game to see if you have learnt all the lessons in this island.

lesson.name: harder silent letters
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 1
lesson.information: Learn the hardest silent letter words e.g. psychologist.

lesson.name: word endings 6
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 2
lesson.information: The sixth and final stage of word endings will complete your pack of flash cards. Includes 'ary', 'ory', 'ate', 'ance', 'ence', 'ism' and 'ology'.

lesson.name: connective 'i' says 'sh' (ti/ci)
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 3
lesson.information: Learn the most advanced words that include 'i' connecting to 't' and 'c' to make a 'sh' sound e.g. 'ci' in special.

lesson.name: sounds saying 'j'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 4
lesson.information: Learn the many letter combinations make a 'j' sound (j/gi/gy/ge/dge/du/di) e.g. soldier.

lesson.name: words ending in 'ar' and 'or'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 5
lesson.information: The word endings 'ar' and 'or' make the same 'er' sound e.g. calculator. This spelling rule will help you use the correct one.

lesson.name: words with 'eu'
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 6
lesson.information: The vowel combination 'eu' makes an 'oo' sound e.g. euphoria.

lesson.name: 'y' as a vowel sound
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 7
lesson.information: Multi-syllable words where 'y' makes several vowel sounds e.g. hysterical, pythagoras.

lesson.name: assimilated prefixes
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 8
lesson.information: The prefix (head) of a word can sometimes be changed or 'assimilated' to become more like the body e.g. ad + fair becomes affair.

lesson.name: advanced prefixes
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 9
lesson.information: This final lesson includes the most advanced multi-syllable words with prefixes (trans/non/per/sub/anti/bi/ob/pre/co) e.g. transparency.

lesson.name: Nessy Challenge game
lesson.guidance: This is your guidance for lesson 10
lesson.information: Are you ready for the next island? Play the Nessy Challenge game to see if you have learnt all the lessons in this island.
